title: Dune: Part Two
synopsis: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the universe, he endeavors to prevent a terrible future.

title: Oppenheimer
cast: Cillian Murphy, Emily Blunt, Matt Damon, Robert Downey Jr.
synopsis: The story of American scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer and his role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II, exploring moral dilemmas and political consequences.

title: Interstellar: 10th Anniversary
cast: Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain
synopsis: When Earth becomes uninhabitable in the future, a farmer and ex-NASA pilot, Joseph Cooper, is tasked to pilot a spacecraft along with a team of researchers to find a new planet for humans.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
cast: Shameik Moore, Hailee Steinfeld, Oscar Isaac
synopsis: Miles Morales catapults across the Multiverse, where he encounters a team of Spider-People charged with protecting its very existence. When heroes clash on how to handle a new threat, Miles must redefine what it means to be a hero.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
cast: Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldana, Sigourney Weaver
synopsis: Jake Sully lives with his newfound family formed on the extrasolar moon Pandora. Once a familiar threat returns to finish what was previously started, Jake must work with Neytiri and the army of the Na'vi race to protect their home.

title: The Dark Knight
cast: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart
synopsis: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.
